trial_court: Family Court, Nanded in Petition No. A-1 of 2021
case_name: Vilas Vitthal Bhure vs Asha Vilas Bhure
facts_of_case: Petitioner's wife filed a proceeding under Section 13 of Hindu Marriage Act against him seeking decree of dissolution of marriage on the ground of cruelty. Petitioner denied allegations and sought to pass decree of divorce.

legal_principles.principle: Unless one of the grounds as contemplated in Section 13 of Hindu Marriage Act is made out, decree of divorce cannot be passed.
legal_principles.held: It is trite that unless one of the grounds as contemplated in Section 13 of Hindu Marriage Act is made out, decree of divorce cannot be passed.

legal_principles.principle: Decree of divorce cannot be passed unless one of the grounds as contemplated in Section 13 of Hindu Marriage Act is made out.

outcome.final_order: Court cannot pass any decree of divorce on the ground of cruelty or any other ground in terms of Section 13 of Hindu Marriage Act. Parties are directed to cooperate for early disposal of petition.

keywords: Latin maxim: actus meatus est lex
